mapper.select: SELECT gc.id, gc.guide_id, gc.user_id, gc.content, gc.parent_comment_id, gc.likes_count, gc.created_at, up.nickname AS author_name, up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url FROM guide_comments gc LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = gc.user_id WHERE gc.guide_id = #{guideId} ORDER BY gc.created_at ASC
